description: NOAA HAIL Storm Reports (24 hours) is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. This map contains continuously updated U.S. tornado reports, wind storm reports and hail storm reports. Click each feature to receive information about the specific location and read a short description about the issue. Now contains ALL available Incident Report types, for a total of 15, not just Hail; Wind; and Tornados. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are    NOAA, Esri, NOAA, NWS, Tornado, Wind, Hail, Storm. The bounding box given is -110.2300,31.3400,-76.4100,44.3800. The hub shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
